title: Show HN: PS2 games statically recompiled to WebAssembly
summary: A project that statically recompiles PlayStation 2 game binaries (MIPS architecture) to WebAssembly, enabling PS2 games to run directly in web browsers without plugins or traditional emulation layers.
problem_solved: Enables legacy PS2 games to run on modern web browsers by translating native MIPS machine code to WebAssembly bytecode.
why_valuable: Preserves gaming history by making PS2 games accessible through a universal, browser-based platform without requiring native installation or traditional dynamic emulation.
